name: TilingAction
description: Partition a loop nest into cache-friendly tiles by introducing inner and outer loop levels using Transform dialect tile_using_for operation. Reduces working-set size and enables vectorization and parallelism of inner loops.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes (one per operation dimension). A value of 0 means no tiling for that dimension. Non-zero values specify the tile size.
